rationale: C23 is an exceptionally strong template: the child expressly identifies the August 24, 2017 directive as an earlier step in the same Venezuela emergency and closely reproduces its compact sequence—targeted financial-transaction prohibition, exceptions clause, anti-evasion and conspiracy provisions, definitions, Treasury implementation and redelegation, agency direction, no-prior-notice finding, and effective date. The child adapts C23's core transaction language from Venezuelan debt, equity, bonds, and distributions to Venezuelan government-issued digital currency. C05 supplies the underlying Venezuela emergency and substantially identical definitions and sanctions machinery, but C23 is the much closer immediate drafting model. C18 has similar contemporary Trump-era phrasing and machinery but concerns a different, broader North Korea sanctions structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All transactions related to, provision of financing for, and other dealings in ... any digital currency, digital coin, or digital token ... issued by, for, or on behalf of the Government of Venezuela ... are prohibited
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All transactions related to, provision of financing for, and other dealings in the following by a United States person or within the United States are prohibited
shared_material.explanation: The child's central operative prohibition directly reuses C23's distinctive transaction-and-financing formulation while substituting Venezuelan digital currency for debt, equity, bonds, and distributions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Any transaction that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate ... is prohibited. Any conspiracy formed to violate ... is prohibited.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any transaction that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate ... is prohibited. Any conspiracy formed to violate ... is prohibited.
shared_material.explanation: The anti-circumvention and conspiracy section is reproduced essentially verbatim and occupies the same position immediately after the substantive prohibition.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the term "Government of Venezuela" means ... including the Central Bank of Venezuela and Petroleos de Venezuela, S.A. (PdVSA), and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government of Venezuela
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the term "Government of Venezuela" means ... including the Central Bank of Venezuela and PdVSA, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government of Venezuela
shared_material.explanation: The child carries forward C23's Venezuela-specific definition, expanding the PdVSA abbreviation but preserving its substance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, is hereby authorized to take such actions, including promulgating rules and regulations ... The Secretary ... may ... redelegate ... All agencies ... shall take all appropriate measures
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, is hereby authorized to take such actions, including promulgating rules and regulations ... The Secretary ... may ... redelegate ... All agencies ... shall take all appropriate measures
shared_material.explanation: The implementation, redelegation, and government-wide execution machinery closely tracks C23 nearly word for word.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For those persons whose property and interests in property are affected by this order ... because of the ability to transfer funds or other assets instantaneously, prior notice ... would render those measures ineffectual
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For those persons whose property or interests in property are affected by this order ... because of the ability to transfer funds or other assets instantaneously, prior notice ... would render those measures ineffectual
shared_material.explanation: The no-prior-notice finding is nearly identical and is placed after the implementation provision, matching C23's sequence.
